steps.action: Tell me what year, month, day, and hour we are currently in.

I’m afraid I don’t have real-time awareness of the calendar or a clock. My training data end in mid-2024, and I don’t receive live updates after that point. If you need the exact current year, month, day, and hour, you can check:

• The clock or calendar on your computer or phone  
• A web search for “current time” in your location  
• A command-line or scripting call such as `date` (Linux/macOS) or `Get-Date` (PowerShell)

Those sources will give you the precise, up-to-the-second information.
